product_scope: itpay is the single public Buyer CLI entry point, and $itpay is its user-facing Skill invocation. It covers services, railway planning and booking, orders, authorized purchased content and refunds.
title: Browse ItPay V3 Service Catalog
purpose: Explain available services, outcomes, conditions, and prices in human language without exposing catalog identifiers.
when_to_use: The buyer wants to see available services before purchasing.
The buyer asks 'what can I buy?' or 'show me services'.
current_flow: Run itpay catalog list --json for a new-service request. Explain published service title, outcome, billing mode, quota and conditions in ordinary language.
Use the returned service operation, full input schema/template and price facts. Internal identifiers are read from results, never guessed or requested from the human.
Railway route understanding belongs to rail-booking. Selected purchases use the current purchase review and the Skill consent rule.
